investigated.name: Hera / Hera Comm
positiveEvidence: Current first-party EV Driver portal is reachable at https://heraricarica.gruppohera.it/ and exposes the live charging-network UI plus a dedicated tariff page.

Current first-party tariff page https://heraricarica.gruppohera.it/home/pages/tariffs explicitly exposes both 'Offerta flat' and 'Offerta a consumo' sections and a deterministic post-charge penalty model.
Penalty after 60 minutes from charge completion: 0.08 EUR/min for Type 2 / Type 3A from 07:00 to 23:00 every day; 0.15 EUR/min for CHAdeMO / Combo CCS2 all day.
negativeEvidence: The currently crawlable first-party tariff page does not expose the numeric energy-price values for the flat/consumption cards in its text payload.
Historical/third-party numeric Hera prices are not promoted because they are not sufficient authority for current direct CPO pricing.
investigated.decision: Remain active station-level fail-closed for energy ranking. Preserve the newly recovered first-party tariff portal and exact post-charge penalty rules; do not repeat the exhausted generic network-wide search.
investigated.resumeCondition: Inspect the current first-party portal frontend/API payload used to populate the flat/consumption tariff cards, or obtain a deterministic current station/EVSE -> direct energy-price mapping from the same first-party system.
investigated.confidence: high for penalty component; fail-closed for energy component

next: Inspect Hera first-party portal tariff-card payload/API before any further HER network-wide search.
Continue the next genuinely unresolved station-level CPO if the portal payload does not expose deterministic energy pricing.
